description: Fix three bugs found in code review: (1) saveDebt loses item details for existing debtors because cart is cleared before saveDebt is called, (2) overpayment is silently discarded in both Market.html and report.html, (3) no debt deletion/cleanup mechanism in Market.html for fully-paid debtors.
steps: Bug 1: In Market.html, capture cart items BEFORE calling completeSale for existing debtors, and pass them to saveDebt
Bug 1: Modify saveDebt to accept a cartItems parameter instead of relying on the global cart array
Bug 2: In Market.html processPayment, add validation to reject payment if amount exceeds total remaining debt
Bug 2: In report.html processPayment, add the same overpayment validation
Bug 3: In Market.html renderDebtors, add a delete/clear button for fully-paid debtors
acceptance_criteria: For existing debtors, debt records contain correct items array (not empty)
Overpayment is rejected with an error message in both files
Fully-paid debtors in Market.html have a delete/clear button that removes their paid debt records
verification: Check that saveDebt receives cartItems parameter
Check that overpayment validation exists in both processPayment functions
Check that delete button exists in the paid debtor card
findings: All three bugs fixed and verified. JavaScript syntax validates cleanly in both files. (1) saveDebt now receives cartItems as a parameter - existing debtors get cart captured before completeSale clears it, new debtors pass cartItems from pendingDebtData. (2) Both processPayment functions now reject payments exceeding total remaining debt with a user-friendly Uzbek error message showing the max allowed. (3) Fully-paid debtor cards in Market.html now show a delete button that calls clearDebtorDebts to remove paid debt records from Firebase.
